test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CHILDREN' is written as ‘FKLOGUHQ’ and ‘SCHOOL’ is written as ‘VFKRRO’, how will 'CLASSROOM' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'CHILDREN' is written as ‘FKLOGUHQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8d6d75ffa70df0501cd6b67367cd3d5144974aba0bbfe604a0ad1948610b9e7.png] 

And,

‘SCHOOL’ is written as ‘VFKRRO’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c97326e248a94a7d8b0def2e58562131f40a59a2724cd2fbf8ecdb876a865e08.png] 

Similarly,

'CLASSROOM' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ae20f5d8bf55665abad4b18120ed43d6c0012d17d7f47df155c936340d5c01e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FODVVURRP".**
